note: Hebrew nazir "one separated/consecrated" has nothing to do with Nazareth; the KJV spelling invites confusion with "Nazarene".

kjv: from the kernels even to the husk
mine: from the seeds to the skins
note: The rare words chartsannim and zag are uncertain (seeds/unripe grapes and skins); the KJV pair is a defensible guess, as is mine.
Hebrew tor is the turtledove; "turtle" in 1611 meant the bird but today suggests the reptile.
